newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs seen steady-lower, pork bellies steady-up.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs seen steady-lower, pork bellies steady-up.

text.p: CME lean hog futures were expected to open steady to 0.200 cent per lb lower while pork bellies were called steady to 0.300 cent higher, livestock analysts said.
Steady to lower cash hog indications, as packers reduce slaughter rates, is expected to weigh on hog futures and reverse some of Tuesday's gains, analysts said.
However, losses will likely be limited by continued support from Japan's announcement it will exempt some pork imports from tariffs during August to combat high domestic prices, sources said.
